usage: The word 單位 (daan1 wai2) refers to an individual apartment unit within a building.
It is commonly used to specify a specific place where someone lives or works.
In sentences, 單位 generally functions as a noun and often follows a number or a quantifier.
You can also use 單位 when talking about the size or price of an apartment unit.
This word can be combined with terms like '新' (new) or '空置' (vacant) to give more detail about the apartment unit.
